Count reads per genomic window

Source: R/read_counts.R
count_reads.Rd

Count reads from per-chromosome read-position files and add raw read counts and raw copy-number estimates to a GRangesList.

Usage

count_reads(
  wins_grl,
  data_dir,
  bad_coords = NULL,
  raw_cn_th = 6,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

wins_grl

A named GRangesList; each element holds the windows of one chromosome, named like "chr1".

data_dir

Directory containing one whitespace-separated read-position file per chromosome, named readsChr<N>.txt where <N> is the element name without the "chr" prefix.

bad_coords

Optional named list (names = chromosome names, as in wins_grl) of read positions to drop before counting, or NULL.

raw_cn_th

Positive numeric threshold for raw_cn.

verbose

Logical; print one progress message per chromosome. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with

wins_count

wins_grl with metadata columns raw_counts (integer) and raw_cn (numeric).

reads_list

named list of numeric read positions per chromosome after removing bad_coords.

Details

Reads are assigned to windows with findInterval() on the cut points c(start(windows), end(last window)), so windows are assumed to be sorted, contiguous and non-overlapping within each chromosome. Reads outside the covered span are dropped. raw_cn = 2 * raw_counts / mean(raw_counts), where the mean is taken over all windows of all chromosomes; values above raw_cn_th or equal to 0 are set to NA.

Examples

d <- tempfile(); dir.create(d)
writeLines(as.character(c(5, 15, 15, 25, 35)), file.path(d, "readsChr1.txt"))
wins <- GenomicRanges::GRangesList(
  chr1 = GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(c(1, 11, 21, 31), width = 10))
)
res <- count_reads(wins, d, verbose = FALSE)
res$wins_count$chr1
#> GRanges object with 4 ranges and 2 metadata columns:
#>       seqnames    ranges strand | raw_counts    raw_cn
#>          <Rle> <IRanges>  <Rle> |  <integer> <numeric>
#>   [1]     chr1      1-10      * |          1       1.6
#>   [2]     chr1     11-20      * |          2       3.2
#>   [3]     chr1     21-30      * |          1       1.6
#>   [4]     chr1     31-40      * |          1       1.6
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 1 sequence from an unspecified genome; no seqlengths
